sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FOR THE NRN/CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... PROGRESSIVE NRN STREAM WILL BE IN PLACE TODAY POLEWARD OF A MIDLEVEL ANTICYCLONE CENTERED OVER THE SWRN/S-CNTRL CONUS. A STRONG UPPER TROUGH WILL ADVANCE E FROM SASKATCHEWAN TO NRN ONTARIO BY 09/12Z...WHILE A SECOND WAVE MOVES FROM THE PAC NW INTO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. A THIRD SHORTWAVE IMPULSE IS ALSO FORECAST TO MOVE FROM THE GREAT BASIN INTO THE NRN PLAINS DURING THE AFTERNOON AND EVENING. MEANWHILE OVER THE E COAST...AN UPPER-LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL MOVE FROM THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION TO OFFSHORE OF SRN NEW ENGLAND BY TONIGHT. A COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH THE CANADIAN DISTURBANCE WILL ADVANCE SWD INTO THE NRN PLAINS LATER TODAY. S OF THIS FEATURE...LOW PRESSURE IS FORECAST TO DEEPEN OVER THE HIGH PLAINS AND EJECT ENEWD TOWARD THE UPPER MS VALLEY OVERNIGHT. A SECOND FRONTAL BOUNDARY ANALYZED EARLY THIS MORNING FROM THE UPPER MIDWEST SWWD INTO THE MID MO RIVER VALLEY WILL GRADUALLY SHIFT SEWD INTO LOWER MI LATER TODAY AND EXTEND WWD TOWARD NEB/SD.

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO INITIATE WITHIN AN UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME FROM THE WRN DAKOTAS/WRN NEB WWD INTO CNTRL MT DURING EARLY TO MID AFTERNOON. SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S AND 60S COMBINED WITH TEMPERATURES WARMING INTO THE 80S WILL BE SURMOUNTED BY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...WHICH WILL AID IN MLCAPE VALUES FROM 1000-3000 J/KG. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FROM 30-40 KT OVER THE WRN DAKOTAS/NEB...TO 40-50 KT OVER MT...WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT INITIALLY. THESE STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING VERY LARGE HAIL. COMPLEX SCENARIO THEN UNFOLDS BY LATE AFTERNOON INTO THE NIGHT. A MIDLEVEL IMPULSE IS FORECAST TO ENTER WRN SD BY EARLY/MID AFTERNOON...AND THEN MOVE ESEWD ACROSS SRN SD INTO NRN IA AFTER DARK. FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS FEATURE...COMBINED WITH AN ELONGATED W-E CORRIDOR OF UPPER 60S/LOW 70S DEWPOINTS AND MODERATE/STRONG CAPE POSITIONED FROM SRN SD/NRN NEB INTO IA...WILL FAVOR UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS. FOCUSED SWATH OF DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE AS A RESULT...AND ENHANCED WIND PROBABILITIES MAY NEED TO BE INTRODUCED IN FUTURE OUTLOOKS. FARTHER N OVER CNTRL MT INTO ND...STRONG UPPER-LEVEL DIVERGENCE IS FORECAST T

sections.title: LOWER MI...NRN IL/IN/OH
sections.text: THUNDERSTORMS OCCURRING ALONG AND AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT EARLY THIS MORNING OVER THE UPPER MS VALLEY AND UPPER MIDWEST MAY PERSIST IN A WEAKENED FORM AS THEY SPREAD SEWD INTO LOWER MI AND NRN IL/IN TOWARD MIDDAY. WITH DEWPOINTS NEAR 70F...MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL BE POSSIBLE AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER WARMS AFTER SUNRISE...WHICH MAY AID IN REDEVELOPMENT/INTENSIFICATION OF STORMS BY EARLY AFTERNOON. MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATES DEEP-LAYER SHEAR NEAR 30 KT WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND LINES POSING AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND THREAT. ..GARNER/SMITH.. 07/08/2013

sections.title: MT/NRN PLAINS THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER INTERIOR WA/ORE WILL PROGRESS EWD OVER MT TODAY...REACHING THE MT/ND BORDER REGION LATE TONIGHT. THIS MIDLEVEL WAVE WILL BE ACCOMPANIED BY A SURFACE COLD FRONT WHICH WILL CROSS CENTRAL MT TODAY AND REACH WRN ND LATE TONIGHT. LEE CYCLOGENESIS IS EXPECTED FROM THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS INTO SE MT...ALONG ANOTHER FRONTAL SEGMENT THAT ARCS SEWD FROM SE MT TO CENTRAL NEB. LOW-MID 60S BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS ARE EXPECTED ACROSS THE DAKOTAS AND E/NE MT...BENEATH THE NE EXTENT OF A STEEP LAPSE RATE PLUME ORIGINATING OVER THE NRN ROCKIES. THE STEEP LAPSE RATES...LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...AND DAYTIME HEATING WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE AOA 2000 J/KG. THE ONGOING CONVECTION ACROSS NW MT WILL LIKELY PERSIST AND SPREAD EWD THROUGH THE DAY...IN THE ZONE OF ASCENT PRECEDING THE MIDLEVEL TROUGH. THE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INTENSIFY ONCE THEY ENCOUNTER THE STRONGER INSTABILITY ACROSS CENTRAL MT THIS AFTERNOON...AND THEN CONTINUE EWD ACROSS ERN MT THIS EVENING AND INTO ND TONIGHT. GIVEN THE MODERATE INSTABILITY...FORECAST WIND PROFILES WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS WITHIN THE LARGER BAND OF CONVECTION...AND SOME OF THESE STORMS COULD PRODUCE VERY LARGE HAIL. OTHERWISE...D

sections.title: WRN SD/NEB/IA THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY REVEALS AN EMBEDDED SPEED MAX MOVING ENEWD FROM NRN UT INTO WY...ON THE NW PERIPHERY OF THE MONSOONAL MOISTURE PLUME AND THE NM UPPER HIGH. THE ZONE OF ASCENT ACCOMPANYING THIS WEAK WAVE WILL REACH THE RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AND STRONGER INSTABILITY ACROSS WRN SD/NW NEB BY EARLY-MID AFTERNOON...WHEN SURFACE HEATING/MIXING WILL HAVE LARGELY ELIMINATED CONVECTIVE INHIBITION. THUS...THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED BY 21Z FROM WRN SD INTO NW NEB...AND STORMS WILL SUBSEQUENTLY SPREAD EWD/SEWD ON THE RELATIVELY COOL/MOIST SIDE OF THE STALLED FRONT ACROSS NEB. SUPERCELLS WITH ISOLATED VERY LARGE HAIL ARE EXPECTED INITIALLY GIVEN MODERATE INSTABILITY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 35-40 KT. STORMS COULD GROW UPSCALE INTO A CLUSTER OR TWO THAT WILL CONTINUE EWD OVERNIGHT ACROSS CENTRAL/NRN NEB AND EVENTUALLY INTO IA FED BY A DEVELOPING SWLY LLJ...WITH A CONTINUED RISK FOR DAMAGING GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL.

sections.title: NRN INDIANA/SRN LOWER MI/NW OH TODAY
sections.text: A REMNANT SHORTWAVE TROUGH/MCV WILL MOVE EWD/ESEWD FROM LAKE MI TO LAKE ERIE BY LATE EVENING. SURFACE HEATING IN ADVANCE OF THIS WAVE...WHERE BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE UPPER 60S...WILL SUPPORT MODERATE INSTABILITY THIS AFTERNOON /MLCAPE AOA 15OO J PER KG/. GIVEN THE MODERATE INSTABILITY AND A BELT OF SOMEWHAT ENHANCED MIDLEVEL FLOW CROSSING THIS AREA...A BROKEN BAND OF STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING A FEW DAMAGING GUSTS THIS AFTERNOON.

sections.title: ERN NC/SE VA TODAY
sections.text: A MIDLEVEL TROUGH WILL MOVE EWD TO THE MID ATLANTIC COAST BY THIS AFTERNOON. PRIOR TO THE WAVE MOVING OFFSHORE...THERE WILL BE A WINDOW OF OPPORTUNITY FOR A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS ACROSS ERN NC/SE VA...WHERE SOMEWHAT STRONGER SURFACE HEATING/INSTABILITY WILL COINCIDE WITH THE SE FRINGE OF THE STRONGER MIDLEVEL FLOW. ..THOMPSON/LEITMAN.. 07/08/2013

sections.title: MT/ND
sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOPS SHOW A WELL-DEFINED AND PROGRESSIVE UPPER TROUGH OVER EASTERN WA/ORE. THIS FEATURE...ALONG WITH A LEADING VORT MAX OVER NORTHERN ID WILL TRACK EASTWARD ACROSS THE NORTHERN ROCKIES TODAY. THIS SHOULD SET THE STAGE FOR AN ACTIVE AFTERNOON/EVENING OF SEVERE STORMS OVER PARTS OF MT. THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING OVER NORTHWEST MT AHEAD OF THE LEAD SHORTWAVE...AND WILL LIKELY PERSIST FOR SEVERAL HOURS AS THEY TRACK EAST-NORTHEASTWARD ALONG/SOUTH OF THE CANADIAN BORDER. THE AIR MASS AHEAD OF THE STORMS IS NOT PARTICULARLY UNSTABLE...SO THE SEVERE THREAT IS LIKELY TO BE LIMITED. NEVERTHELESS...ISOLATED STRONG/SEVERE STORMS WITH HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE. A MORE SUBSTANTIAL RISK OF SEVERE WEATHER WILL EVOLVE LATER THIS AFTERNOON AS THE PRIMARY UPPER TROUGH APPROACHES FROM THE WEST. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP OVER WEST/WEST-CENTRAL MT AND TRACK EASTWARD THROUGH MUCH OF THE EVENING. SEVERAL OVERNIGHT AND 12Z MODEL SOLUTIONS SUGGEST SUPERCELLS WILL ORGANIZE INTO BOWING LINE SEGMENTS ACROSS THIS AREA. HIGH LCL HEIGHTS SHOULD LIMIT THE TORNADO RISK...BUT VERY LARGE HAIL AND SWATHS OF WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS ARE POSSIBLE. STORMS MAY MAINTAIN SEVERE INTENSITY AS FA

sections.title: WY/SD/NEB/IA
sections.text: ANOTHER SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS INDICATED IN WATER VAPOR IMAGERY OVER SOUTHERN WY. THIS SYSTEM WILL APPROACH THE HIGH PLAINS OF WESTERN SD/NEB TODAY FOSTERING THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. SOUTHEASTERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS IN THIS REGION WILL MAINTAIN DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S...WHICH ALONG WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES AND POCKETS OF STRONG AFTERNOON HEATING WILL RESULT IN MODERATE MLCAPE. IT IS UNCLEAR WHETHER PRIMARY INITIATION WILL BE ON THE WEST EDGE OF THE DEEPER MOISTURE IN EASTERN WY...OVER PERHAPS ASSOCIATED WITH THE ONGOING CONVECTION OVER SD. REGARDLESS...VERTICAL SHEAR IS FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. THESE STORMS MAY ORGANIZE INTO AN MCS AND PERSIST MUCH OF THE NIGHT ACROSS PARTS OF NEB/SD INTO IA.

sections.title: IND/OH/LWR MI
sections.text: THE REMNANTS OF AN OVERNIGHT MCS ARE TRACKING EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS PARTS OF LOWER MI/NORTHWEST IND/CENTRAL IL. STRONG HEATING IS OCCURRING AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY...WHERE DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE UPPER 60S AND MLCAPE VALUES SHOULD REACH 2000+ J/KG. WHILE THE TIMING IS UNCERTAIN...THE POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR REDEVELOPMENT OF INTENSE STORMS ALONG THE REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WOULD BE THE MAIN THREAT. SEVERAL 12Z MODEL SOLUTIONS SUPPORT THIS SCENARIO. ..HART/ROGERS.. 07/08/2013

sections.title: MT/ND
sections.text: AS A STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH PROGRESSES EWD ACROSS THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN WEST TOWARD THE NRN ROCKIES...SCATTERED STRONG/SEVERE STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED IN ADVANCE OF THE SYSTEM FROM WRN INTO NRN MT. A FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC PATTERN IS SUPPORTIVE OF INCREASING SEVERE THREAT THROUGH THE EVENING AS AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE /SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S/ COUPLED WITH SUFFICIENT HEATING IS LOCATED ALONG THE NRN PERIPHERY OF STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES...ENHANCED BY STRONG DIRECTIONAL/SPEED SHEAR IN THE LOW-MID LEVELS. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY ORGANIZE INTO BOWING LINE SEGMENTS ACROSS CENTRAL/ERN MT POSSIBLY SPREADING INTO ND TONIGHT. THIS IS SUPPORTED BY MORNING CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL GUIDANCE INCLUDING THE LATEST HRRR THAT INDICATE POTENTIAL FOR SIGNIFICANT SEVERE WIND GUSTS AS A COMPOSITE COLD POOL GROWS UPSCALE...AND THIS HAS BEEN INCLUDED IN THE SEVERE WIND GRAPHICS FROM MT INTO WRN ND. OTHERWISE...MINOR ADJUSTMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE TO EXTEND THE SEVERE RISK AREA SLIGHTLY FARTHER WEST IN MT BASED ON CURRENT STORM INITIATION REGIONS.

sections.title: WY/SD/NEB/IA
sections.text: CONSENSUS OF CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODELS CONTINUES TO SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS MOVING ACROSS THE NRN NEB/SRN SD REGION LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT...IN ASSOCIATION WITH A SHORT WAVE TROUGH EVIDENT IN WATER VAPOR IMAGERY MOVING INTO THE HIGH PLAINS. THE ENVIRONMENT IS CHARACTERIZED BY SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY /MLCAPE 1500-2500 J PER KG/ ALONG THE SRN EDGE OF STRONGER WINDS ALOFT AND VERTICAL SHEAR. TO BETTER INDICATE THE POTENTIAL FOR A CORRIDOR OF SEVERE STORMS WITH ENHANCED DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL ASSOCIATED WITH A BOWING LINEAR MCS...A 30% WIND PROBABILITY AREA HAS BEEN ADDED FROM NRN NEB/SRN SD EWD INTO WRN IA/SWRN MN FOR TONIGHT. SEE MCD 1347 FOR MORE DETAILS.

sections.title: EXTREME SERN LOWER MI INTO NRN OH
sections.text: THE SMALL SLIGHT RISK THREAT AREA HAS BEEN ADJUSTED EWD TO BE CO-LOCATED WITH A NARROW INSTABILITY AXIS COINCIDENT WITH A THUNDERSTORM BAND EXTENDING FROM SERN LOWER MI INTO NORTH CENTRAL OHIO. ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE MOST LIKELY THREAT BEFORE STORMS DIMINISH LATER THIS EVENING.

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC REGION
sections.text: A FEW STORMS MAY PERSIST INTO THIS EVENING IS ASSOCIATION WITH AN UPPER LOW MOVING SLOWLY EWD ACROSS PA. BRIEF GUSTY WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH STRONGER CELLS. ..WEISS.. 07/08/2013 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1113 AM CDT MON JUL 08 2013/

SEVERAL 12Z MODEL SOLUTIONS SUPPORT THIS SCENARIO.

sections.title: CNTRL/ERN MT INTO THE DAKOTAS
sections.text: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING ACROSS ERN MT AND WRN ND THIS EVENING. DEWPOINTS ACROSS THE AREA ARE IN THE LOW 60S...WITH MID 60S LOCATED FARTHER E OVER THE CNTRL DAKOTAS. THIS MOISTURE COMBINED WITH A PLUME OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES IS YIELDING MODERATE INSTABILITY. A 50 KT MIDLEVEL WLY SPEED MAX IS CURRENTLY SPREADING EWD INTO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS...AND IS SUPPORTING EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES FROM 50-60 KT OVER MT...AND 40-50 KT ACROSS THE WRN DAKOTAS. THIS ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS POSING A RISK FOR VERY LARGE HAIL DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. HOWEVER...UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A BOWING MCS APPEARS LIKELY DURING THE OVERNIGHT. NRN SEGMENT OF THE QLCS IS FORECAST TO MOVE ACROSS WRN/CNTRL ND...WITH SEWD PROPAGATION ACROSS NWRN/N-CNTRL SD ALSO POSSIBLE. AS THIS TAKES PLACE...PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREAT WILL BE DAMAGING WINDS. REFERENCE MCD 1350 FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM DETAILS.

sections.title: NEB...SRN SD...IA...SRN MN
sections.text: WEAK QUASI-STATIONARY FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDS FROM ERN IA INTO ERN NEB...AND THEN WNWWD INTO NWRN NEB. AXIS OF UPPER 60S TO LOW 70S DEWPOINTS IS LOCATED ALONG AND N OF THE BOUNDARY FROM ERN/CNTRL IA INTO SERN/CNTRL SD...AND IS SUPPORTING MLCAPE VALUES FROM 1500-2500 J/KG. ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS ARE OCCURRING ALONG AND N OF THE BOUNDARY THIS EVENING...WITH VEERING WIND PROFILES SUPPORTIVE OF UPDRAFT ROTATION AND A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL. THERE IS SOME POTENTIAL FOR MCS DEVELOPMENT TONIGHT AS INCREASING CONVERGENCE/WAA WITHIN THE EXIT REGION OF A 30-40 KT NOCTURNAL LLJ INTERACTS WITH THE MOIST/UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. IF THIS SCENARIO OCCURS...THEN THE RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL CONTINUE OVERNIGHT ACROSS SRN SD...NRN/CNTRL NEB AND PORTIONS OF IA/SRN MN. REFERENCE MCD 1351 FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM DETAILS.

sections.title: NRN AND CNTRL PORTIONS OF IL/IN/OH
sections.text: EXTENSIVE SHIELD OF LOW CLOUDINESS ASSOCIATED WITH A DEPARTING MIDLEVEL IMPULSE RESIDES ACROSS MUCH OF LOWER MI INTO OH. HOWEVER...WLY FLOW IN THE SURFACE-850 MB LAYER IS PRESENT OVER NRN IL...WHICH IS AIDING IN WEAK WAA AND MODEST DESTABILIZATION. GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF LOW 70S DEWPOINTS...ESTIMATES OF MLCAPE RANGE FROM 1500-2500 J/KG. AS A RESULT...CLUSTERS OF STORMS ARE FORMING FROM FAR ERN IA INTO SERN WI/NERN IL AND NRN IN...AND MAY SPREAD SEWD INTO PORTIONS OF CNTRL IL/IN AND OH. SHEAR PROFILES ARE FAIRLY WEAK ACROSS THE REGION /0-6 KM BULK SHEAR LESS THAN 30 KT/...BUT STRONGER CORES MAY POSE A BRIEF THREAT FOR GUSTY WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL.

sections.title: SERN AZ...EXTREME SWRN NM
sections.text: HIGH BASED THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD SEWD ACROSS SERN AZ AND EXTREME SWRN NM THIS EVENING...WHERE SURFACE TEMPERATURE/DEWPOINT SPREADS ARE QUITE LARGE. THE DRY BOUNDARY LAYER AIRMASS WILL AID IN EVAPORATION OF PRECIPITATION IN THE SUB-CLOUD LAYER AND PROMOTE AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR DAMAGING DOWNDRAFTS. ..GARNER.. 07/09/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT MAY EXIST ACROSS NCNTRL MT LATE THIS MORNING INTO EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. HAIL AND STRONG GUSTY WINDS WILL LIKELY BE THE PRIMARY THREATS BUT SHOULD REMAIN TOO ISOLATED FOR WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CONVECTIVE LINE LOCATED ALONG THE INTERSTATE-15 CORRIDOR...INTENSIFIED AS IT CROSSED THE CONTINENTAL DIVIDE EARLIER THIS MORNING BEING AIDED BY THE HIGHER TERRAIN. THE LINE IS ALSO BEING SUPPORTED BY A WELL-DEFINED VORTICITY MAX EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. AS SFC TEMPS CONTINUE TO WARM AHEAD OF THE LINE LATE THIS MORNING INTO EARLY THIS AFTERNOON AND AS THE LINE MOVES INTO INCREASING LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE TO THE EAST...SOME INTENSIFICATION WILL BE POSSIBLE. 0-6 KM SHEAR AROUND 40 KT EVIDENT ON REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS AND STEEP LOW TO MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OF 8.0 C/KM COULD BE ENOUGH FOR A WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL THREAT. AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY ALSO DEVELOP WITH DISCRETE CELLS THAT CAN INITIATE TO THE EAST OF THE LINE. DUE TO THE RELATIVELY WEAK INSTABILITY THAT IS IN PLACE...THE SEVERE THREAT ASSOCIATED WITH THE LINE IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED THIS MORNING. HOWEVER...IT STILL APPEARS THAT THE MORE SUBSTANTIAL SEVERE THREAT WILL DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS PARTS OF THE AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS LIKELY TO DEVELOP ACROSS PARTS OF WRN AND CNTRL MT THIS AFTERNOON. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE NECESSARY AS STORM COVERAGE INCREASES OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST WITH A LEAD VORTICITY MAX MOVING ACROSS NW MT. STORM COVERAGE SHOULD STEADILY EXPAND THIS AFTERNOON AS LARGE-SCALE ASCENT INCREASES IN WRN AND CNTRL MT OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ALTHOUGH THE STRONGER INSTABILITY IS ANALYZED FROM GREAT FALLS EWD...LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES HAVE BECOME STEEPEST ACROSS WRN MT WITH 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES ESTIMATED AROUND 8.0 C/KM. GIVEN THAT SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE LOWER TO MID 50S F ACROSS MUCH OF WRN MT...OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS APPEARS TO BE UNDERESTIMATING THE AMOUNT OF CAPE. IN ADDITION...THE MISSOULA WSR-88D VWP SHOWS 40-45 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR. THIS ENVIRONMENT SHOULD SUPPORT SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON. DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE ESPECIALLY AS SFC TEMPS CONTINUE TO WARM AND STORMS COVERAGE INCREASES OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR STRONG AND POSSIBLY A FEW SVR WIND GUSTS MAY DEVELOP OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HRS ACROSS SERN LOWER MI INTO N-CNTRL OH. BRIEF/MARGINAL NATURE OF THE THREAT DOES NOT APPEAR TO WARRANT A WW ATTM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BROKEN LINE OF TSTMS HAS DEVELOPED ACROSS ERN LOWER MI SWD INTO NWRN OH...LOCATED ALONG A WIND SHIFT AHEAD OF AN MCV MOVING OVER LM. RADAR TRENDS INDICATE THIS ACTIVITY HAS BEEN SLOWLY INTENSIFYING...AND WILL ENCOUNTER A DESTABILIZING AIR MASS DOWNSTREAM AS TEMPERATURES ARE HEATING INTO THE LOWER 80S F WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 70S F...YIELDING ESTIMATED MLCAPE VALUES BETWEEN 1500-2000 J/KG. ALTHOUGH DEEP-LAYER SHEAR MAGNITUDES ARE QUITE MODEST /20-30 KTS/...A THREAT FOR STRONG-SVR WINDS COULD MATERIALIZE THROUGH THE NEXT 1-2 HRS ACROSS SERN LOWER MI...ESPECIALLY WITHIN SMALL LINE SEGMENTS. FARTHER S ACROSS N-CNTRL OH...LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE APPEARS TO BE WEAKER AS SFC WIND DIRECTIONS ARE MORE UNIFORM /S-SWLY/...BUT A SIMILAR THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT COULD SUPPORT A STRONG-SVR WIND THREAT...AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL THREAT AS WELL IF ACTIVITY CAN REMAIN DISCRETE...AS THE UPSTREAM MCV APPROACHES THE AREA. A WW IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT ACROSS NCNTRL AND NERN MT APPEARS LIKELY TO INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON. WIND DAMAGE AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED SOON ACROSS THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL DISCRETE THUNDERSTORMS HAVE PERSISTED FROM LATE MORNING INTO EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. THE CELLS ARE BEING SUPPORTED BY A LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A VORTICITY MAX EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY IN NCNTRL MT. THE STORMS ARE LOCATED ALONG AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WHERE MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED IN THE 1000 TO 1500 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION...THE GLASGOW WSR-88D VWP SHOWS 50 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR WHICH SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL. A WIND DAMAGE THREAT SHOULD EXIST WITH THE FASTER MOVING BOWING LINE-SEGMENTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HRS FROM ERN WY INTO S-CNTRL SD AND CNTRL NEB. PRIMARY THREATS OF DMGG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL LIKELY REQUIRE A WW THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE FOCUS FOR INCREASING TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED TO LARGELY CENTER AROUND TWO PRIMARY AREAS. /1/ A SHORTWAVE UPPER TROUGH MOVING INTO WRN NEB...WITH INCREASING SFC-BASED AND MIDLEVEL CU AHEAD OF THIS FEATURE NOTED RECENTLY ON VISIBLE SATELLITE LOOP...AND /2/...A LEE SFC TROUGH OVER THE HIGH PLAINS OF ERN WY/NERN CO. A CLUSTER OF ELEVATED TSTMS ACROSS S-CNTRL SD HAS SHOWN A STEADY WEAKENING TREND...BUT COULD ALSO SERVE AS A SOURCE FOR RE-INTENSIFICATION LATER THIS AFTERNOON. AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ASSOCIATED WITH OVERNIGHT CONVECTION ACROSS N-CNTRL NEB HAS BECOME MORE DIFFUSE WITH TIME...WITH GENERALLY UNIFORM AND WEAK E AND SELY LOW-LEVEL FLOW ACROSS THE AREA. INCREASING TSTM COVERAGE ASSOCIATED WITH THE AFOREMENTIONED MESOSCALE FEATURES SHOULD OCCUR WITHIN THE NEXT COUPLE HRS FROM ERN WY EWD INTO S-CNTRL SD AND CNTRL NEB. MODIFIED FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THE AIR MASS CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE WITH TEMPERATURES HEATING INTO THE 90S F...YIELDING MLCAPE VALUES OVER 2000 J/KG. LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY AN ISOLATED TORNADO COULD ACCOMPANY TSTMS INITIALLY WITH MORE DISCRETE/SUPERCELLULAR MODES...BUT EVOLUTION INTO SMALL LINE SEGMENTS OR A MCS LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING SHOULD EVENTUALLY YIELD A PRIMARY THREAT OF DMGG WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS LIKELY TO DEVELOP ACROSS NW MT THIS AFTERNOON. HAIL AND A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: OVER THE LAST HOUR...STORM COVERAGE HAS INCREASED IN THE VICINITY OF KALISPELL DUE TO SFC HEATING AND LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH DOWNSTREAM. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SUGGESTS THAT MLCAPE VALUES ACROSS NW MT ARE AROUND 1000 J/KG WITH 500 MB TEMPS IN THE -14C TO -16C RANGE. THIS ALONG WITH 35 TO 40 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR EVIDENT ON REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR HAIL AS DISCRETE CELLS INITIATE AND STRENGTHEN OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY ALSO OCCUR AS THE MORE MATURE CELLS GUST OUT. ANY SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN MARGINAL. WILL MONITOR TRENDS AND A WW MAY BE NEEDED IF THE COVERAGE OF STRONG STORMS BECOMES MORE WIDESPREAD THAN IS CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TSTMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP ALONG A QUASI-STATIONARY BOUNDARY OVER W-CNTRL AND CNTRL IA...AND MAY POSE A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS. DUE TO THE EXPECTED LOCALIZED NATURE OF THE THREAT...A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED ATTM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MCV CLEARLY EVIDENT ON VISIBLE SATELLITE LOOP IS CURRENTLY LOCATED OVER THE MO RIVER...AND IS PROGRESSING EWD INTO SW AND CNTRL IA. INCREASING ASCENT AHEAD OF THIS FEATURE IS APPROACHING A WEAKLY CONVERGENT QUASI-STATIONARY BOUNDARY DRAPED W-E ACROSS IA /POSITIONED FROM NEAR SUX TO 10 S ALO AS OF 20Z/. ONE LONE TSTM WAS NOTED OVER MONONA COUNTY ALONG THIS BOUNDARY AND WAS SHOWING SIGNS OF INCREASING INTENSITY. ADDITIONAL ISOLATED TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HRS INTO CNTRL PORTIONS OF IA...PRIMARILY ALONG THE BOUNDARY. STRONG HEATING WITHIN A MOISTURE-RICH BOUNDARY LAYER IS YIELDING MLCAPE VALUES EXCEEDING 2500 J/KG. THIS...ALONG WITH MODERATE EFFECTIVE SHEAR NEAR 30 KTS...COULD RESULT IN BRIEF SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH AN ENHANCED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS. THE PRIMARY LIMITING FACTOR IS EXPECTED TO BE SPARSE COVERAGE OF CONVECTION...GIVEN BACKGROUND MIDLEVEL RIDGING/HEIGHT RISES IN THE WAKE OF AN EARLIER SHORTWAVE UPPER TROUGH...WHICH WILL PROBABLY PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WW LIKELY WILL BE REQUIRED OVER AT LEAST SERN PORTIONS MT AHEAD OF SVR CONVECTION EXITING WW 398. MORE CONDITIONAL SVR POTENTIAL EXTENDS SWD ACROSS ERN WY AND PORTIONS WRN SD/NEB PANHANDLE. WW MAY INCLUDE SOME OF THOSE AREAS AS WELL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION NOW OVER CENTRAL MT IS EXPECTED TO EXIT WW 398 AROUND 2230Z...WHILE PROCEEDING INTO FAVORABLE AIR MASS. NARROW CORRIDOR OF RELATIVELY MAXIMIZED BOUNDARY-LAYER THETAE EXTENDS NWWD FROM SRN SD AROUND AREA OF STABILIZED AIR FROM EARLIER CLOUDS/PRECIP OVER CENTRAL/WRN SD...INTO SERN/E-CENTRAL MT. THIS SUPPORTS 1500-2000 J/KG MLCAPE OVER ERN MT AND NERN WY. FARTHER S...WIDELY SCATTERED CONVECTION HAS DEVELOPED OVER HIGHER TERRAIN OF ERN WY...BUT APPEARS TO BE STRUGGLING WITH MASS CONTINUITY. BUOYANCY AND LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE EACH INCREASE WITH EWD EXTENT FROM THAT ACTIVITY...WITH SFC DEW POINTS 40S OVER MUCH OF ERN WY AND 50S OVER NEB PANHANDLE W OF WW 400. MODIFIED RAOBS AND MODEL SOUNDINGS EACH INDICATING MLCAPE 500-1000 J/KG NEAR WY/NEB BORDER AND INCREASING EWD. DEEP SHEAR DECREASES WITH SWD EXTENT...WITH EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES GENERALLY 30-40 KT OVER SERN MT AND FCST TO INCREASE WITH TIME AS NRN ROCKIES SHORTWAVE TROUGH APCHS. MEANWHILE EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES SHOULD REMAIN IN 25-35 KT RANGE OVER ERN WY...SWRN SD AND WRN NEB. MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY SHOWS STG DRYING AND IMPLIED SUBSIDENCE ALOFT OVER ERN WY/NEB PANHANDLE REGION...BEHIND SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW CROSSING S-CENTRAL SD AND N-CENTRAL NEB.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR THREAT FCST TO SHIFT EWD ACROSS WW 399 AND OVER WRN ND THROUGH EVENING...THEREFORE ANOTHER WW IS LIKELY FOR PORTIONS ND. CONVECTION OVER S-CENTRAL/CENTRAL MT HAS STABILIZED BOUNDARY LAYER IN ITS WAKE AND ACCORDINGLY REDUCED SVR THREAT OVER WRN PORTIONS WW 398...THOUGH POCKETS OF FAVORABLE BUOYANCY MAY LINGER OVER W-CENTRAL MT AHEAD OF ISOLATED STG-SVR TSTMS MOVING EWD FROM MTNS NE MSO. WW 398 MAY BE CLEARED FROM W-E BEFORE SCHEDULED EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWED SLOW-MOVING COLD FRONT FROM SWRN MB SWWD ACROSS N-CENTRAL/W-CENTRAL ND...NEAR PERSISTENT SUPERCELL AND INCREASING SURROUNDING CONVECTION OVER SRN MCCONE/NRN PRAIRIE COUNTIES MT...BECOMING QUASISTATIONARY SWWD TO LOW INVOF BIL. RELATIVE MAX IN SFC DEW POINTS WAS EVIDENT N OF FRONT OVER NWRN ND...WITH MOIST AXIS WSWWD TOWARD ERN MT TSTMS THEN SWWD BEHIND THAT CONVECTION TO JUST NE OF SFC LOW. MLCAPE 1000-1500 J/KG SHOULD REMAIN COMMON NEAR THAT MOIST PLUME. SIMILAR VALUES WERE EVIDENT NEAR THETAE AXIS EXTENDING AROUND WRN AND NWRN RIM OF DIFFERENTIAL-HEATING/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ANALYZED FROM S-CENTRAL ND SWWD ACROSS MT/SD BORDER AREA THEN SEWD OVER SWRN SD. THIS PRECONVECTIVE AIR MASS...BENEATH 40-50 KT WLY EFFECTIVE SHEAR VECTORS...SHOULD SUPPORT POTENTIAL FOR MT CONVECTION TO EXPAND AND MOVE EWD ACROSS REMAINDER MT AND INTO PORTIONS WRN ND AND NWRN SD. GREATEST THREAT SHOULD BE FOCUSED INVOF FRONTAL ZONE WHERE LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW EACH SHOULD BE MAXIMIZED. EITHER PRIMARY CLUSTER OF TSTMS -- OVER ERN AND S-CENTRAL MT -- MAY DEVELOP UPSCALE COLD POOL WITH RESULTING ENHANCEMENT TO WIND-DAMAGE THREAT. MEANWHILE...VERY LARGE/DAMAGING HAIL AND SVR DOWNDRAFT GUSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH RELATIVELY DISCRETE SUPERCELLS. ..EDWARDS.. 07/08/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE NEED FOR A NEW ADDITIONAL WATCH BEYOND 0200 UTC IS UNCERTAIN BUT BECOMING LESS LIKELY WITH TIME AND TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A FEW STORMS OVER N-CNTRL NE WITH SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY HAVING RECENTLY WEAKENED CONSIDERABLY OR DISSIPATED. THE DISCUSSION AREA IS LOCATED BENEATH A PRONOUNCED MID-LEVEL DRY PATCH DENOTED IN WATER VAPOR...APPARENTLY IMPLYING SOME LARGE-SCALE SUBSIDENCE. FURTHERMORE...THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL GRADUALLY COOL OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS DECREASING SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY. DESPITE THESE LIMITING FACTORS...WARM ADVECTION IS FORECAST TO INCREASE OVER THE AREA BY MID-EVENING AS A LLJ INTENSIFIES TO 40 KT INVOF THE N-CNTRL KS/S-CNTRL NE BORDER LATE TONIGHT. A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER CHARACTERIZED BY DEWPOINTS RANGING FROM THE LOWER 70S NEAR THE MO RIVER IN S-CNTRL SD TO THE MID 50S IN ERN PORTIONS OF THE NE PANHANDLE HAS LED TO MODERATE INSTABILITY /1400 J/KG MLCAPE PER 00Z/09 LBF RAOB/. GIVEN THE ISOLD STORM COVERAGE AND A POTENTIALLY SUPPORTIVE ENVIRONMENT FOR ISOLD SEVERE...WILL MONITOR TRENDS AS TO WHETHER SEVERE WATCH 400 WILL BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 0200 UTC. ..SMITH.. 07/09/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WWS MAY BE CLEARED FROM W-E BEHIND PRIMARY TSTM COMPLEXES OVER WRN ND AND ERN MT. PORTIONS WW 399 OVER ERN MT HAVE BEEN EXTENDED IN TIME TO 03Z PER COORD W/GGW. EWD PERSISTENCE OF CONVECTION ACROSS SD IS UNCERTAIN GIVEN MORE STABLE AIR MASS THERE. HOWEVER...INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED COLD-POOL AGGREGATION WITH EXISTING CONVECTION...ALONG WITH FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL ENVIRONMENT DOWNSHEAR OVER ND...INDICATES ANOTHER WW MAY BE REQUIRED WITHIN NEXT 2-3 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TWO PRIMARY INITIAL CONVECTIVE COMPLEXES WERE EVIDENT AT 0130Z... 1. MCKENZIE/DUNN COUNTIES ND SWWD TO NEAR BHK...MOVING ESEWD 30-35 KT WITH LOCAL ACCELERATIONS DUE TO MERGERS WITH FOREGOING TSTMS...AND 2. PRAIRIE COUNTY MT SWD OVER PORTIONS CUSTER/POWDER RIVER COUNTIES...MOVING EWD 45-50 KT. MESONET MEASURED 70-KT GUST IN CUSTER COUNTY MT AT 0040Z...AND SEVERAL OTHER GUSTS OF BOTH ESTIMATED AND MEASURED SVR INTENSITY HAVE OCCURRED DURING PAST 2 HOURS. THESE COMPLEXES SHOULD MERGE INTO MORE CONTINUOUS/SINGLE QLCS WITHIN NEXT HOUR OVER SERN MT...GIVEN FASTER FORWARD PROPAGATION OF TRAILING CONVECTION AND INTERVENING DEVELOPMENT NEAR OUTFLOW FROM FIRST BAND. RESULTING QLCS WILL CONTINUE TO OFFER DAMAGING GUSTS AND OCNL LARGE HAIL AS IT MOVES EWD TO ESEWD ACROSS MT/NWRN SD PORTIONS WW 401...AND FROM WRN INTO CENTRAL ND. MAIN UNCERTAINTY ATTM INVOLVES RELATIVE IMPORTANCE OF 1. STRENGTHENING FORCED ASCENT AS COLD-POOL ORGANIZATION IMPROVES WITH QLCS...OFFSET TO SOME EXTENT BY 2. POCKET OF RELATIVELY STABLE BOUNDARY-LAYER AIR LEFT OVER AND ADVECTED NNWWD FROM AREA OF DIURNAL CLOUD/PRECIP COVER OVER CENTRAL SD. THIS INDICATES SOME POTENTIAL FOR WEAKENING OF CONVECTION AT SOME POINT AFTER ENTERING NWRN SD AND INVOF SD/ND BORDER. WHAT IS UNCERTAIN IS HOW DEEPLY INTO THIS AIR MASS QLCS CAN PENETRATE AT SVR LEVELS. FARTHER N...MORE MOIST/UNDISTURBED/CONVERGENT BOUNDARY LAYER OVER WRN/CENTRAL ND...NEAR AND AHEAD OF WEAK SFC COLD FRONT...SHOULD SUPPORT EWD/FORWARD PROPAGATION OF TSTMS NOW OVER WRN SD. NOCTURNAL COOLING SHOULD BE SLOW TO DIMINISH 1000-1500 J/KG MLCAPE EVIDENT IN 00Z BIS/ABR RAOBS AND MODIFIED MODEL SOUNDINGS. DEEP-LAYER FLOW WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE WITH DIFLUENCE ALOFT...AVERAGE EFFECTIVE-SHEAR VECTOR BEING AT ABOUT 40 KT...AND WITH SUBSTANTIAL COMPONENT ORTHOGONAL TO

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WW 400 HAS BEEN EXTENDED LOCALLY UNTIL 04Z...COVERING SVR POTENTIAL ACROSS PORTIONS SRN SD INTO NEB SANDHILLS. HOWEVER...ORGANIZED DAMAGING WIND THREAT MAY INCREASE OVER THOSE AREAS AHEAD OF INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED QLCS. AS SUCH...PORTIONS NRN NEB AND SRN SD WILL BE MONITORED FOR NEW WW ISSUANCE. FARTHER S...SVR POTENTIAL OVER SRN NEB APPEARS MORE ISOLATED/TRANSIENT...AND WW IS UNLIKELY THERE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED ARC OF TSTMS OVER WRN SANDHILLS AND SERN PANHANDLE OF NEB MAY DEVELOP SUFFICIENTLY ROBUST COLD POOL TO OFFER ORGANIZED WIND-DAMAGE RISK AS IT MOVES EWD THROUGH SANDHILLS AND ADJACENT PARTS OF SRN SD. SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWS TWO PRIMARY BOUNDARIES... 1. OLD OUTFLOW/DIFFERENTIAL-HEATING ZONE LEFT BEHIND BY DIURNAL PRECIP OVER CENTRAL/SRN SD. THIS FEATURE IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MORE DIFFUSE WITH TIME OVER SRN SD AMIDST LOW-LEVEL WAA/MOISTURE TRANSPORT. 2. FRESHER BUT SMALLER AREA OF OUTFLOW...OUTLINED BY DECELERATING BOUNDARY ARCHING ACROSS PORTIONS HOLT/BLAINE/THOMAS/CHERRY COUNTIES. WRN PART OF THIS AIR MASS IS LEAST AFFECTED...WITH 68 DEG F DEW POINT AT VTN AT 02Z. HOWEVER...AIR MASS WILL BECOME MORE STABLE WITH EWD EXTENT FROM THERE ACROSS REMAINDER N-CENTRAL NEB. THIS POTENTIALLY FAVORS CENTRAL/SRN PART OF MCS AS MOST PROBABLE SVR-WIND CORRIDOR -- NEAR AND S OF BOUNDARY. NARROW RIBBON OF RELATIVELY UNDISTURBED NEAR-SFC AIR ALSO IS EVIDENT OVER SRN SD S OF OLDER BOUNDARY. IN S-CENTRAL/SERN SD...SFC DEW POINTS 70S F SHOULD TEMPER DIABATIC COOLING...YIELDING ONLY VERY GRADUAL INCREASE IN INITIALLY WEAK MLCINH...AND SUPPORT MLCAPE 1500-2500 J/KG FOR ANOTHER 3-4 HOURS. ISOLATED SVR GUST OF 53 KT OCCURRED AT MCK AT 226Z. BOTH BUOYANCY AND DEEP SHEAR WEAKEN WITH SWD EXTENT INTO SRN NEB...THOUGH REMNANTS OF DEEPLY WELL-MIXED SUBCLOUD LAYER MAY SUPPORT POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED SVR GUSTS WITH CONVECTION IN THAT AREA UNTIL NEAR-SFC LATER STABILIZES DUE TO COMBINED EFFECTS OF OUTFLOW AND SFC DIABATIC COOLING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONTINUE WW 403. WWS MAY BE CLEARED BEHIND TWO PRIMARY CONVECTIVE SYSTEMS WHERE COLD POOL HAS BECOME WELL-ESTABLISHED AND ANY REMAINING ELEVATED CONVECTION SHOULD BE LARGELY NON-SVR. PORTIONS WWS 401/402 MAY BE LOCALLY EXTENDED AS LOCATION/TIMING OF TRAILING MCS WARRANT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SVR WIND POTENTIAL REMAINS WITH MCS MOVING EWD ASTRIDE WRN PORTIONS SD/ND BORDER...HOWEVER OVERALL WIND THREAT FARTHER N HAS DIMINISHED WITH GUST FRONT MOVING WELL AHEAD OF CENTRAL ND COMPLEX. AT 252Z...NERN SD/SWRN ND MCS PRODUCED MEASURED/SIGNIFICANT-SEVERE 74-KT GUST AT 2WX. SINCE THEN...MEASURED SPEEDS WITH THIS ACTIVITY HAVE DIMINISHED SOME AS CONVECTION MOVES INTO SOMEWHAT MORE STABLE AIR MASS LEFT BEHIND BY AREA OF DIURNAL CLOUDS/PRECIP...AND MORE CERTAINLY BEHIND FRESH/COLDER OUTFLOW OVER ND. HOWEVER...COLD POOL IS SUFFICIENTLY WELL-DEVELOPED...WITH SUBSTANTIAL ASSOCIATED PRESSURE PERTURBATIONS...THAT FORCED ASCENT MAY SUSTAIN RELATED CONVECTION UNTIL IT MERGES WITH INITIALLY LESS WELL-ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE CLUSTER OVER N-CENTRAL SD. IF IT SURVIVES THAT PROCESS...COMBINED COLD POOL MAY BE REINFORCED AND PENETRATE MORE FAVORABLY MOIST/HIGH-THETAE AIR MASS OVER NERN SD. ACCORDINGLY...GREATEST CONDITIONAL SVR THREAT SHOULD BE IN CORRIDOR FROM PORTIONS CORSON/DEWEY COUNTIES EWD ACROSS ABR AREA...WHERE POCKETS OF 1000-2000 J/KG MLCAPE...RELATIVELY WEAK CINH AND 35-45 KT WLY EFFECTIVE SHEAR VECTORS SHOULD PERSIST ANOTHER FEW HOURS. LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS ALSO MAY BE POSSIBLE WITH N-CENTRAL SD CONVECTION BEFORE IT IS OVERTAKEN BY UPSHEAR COMPLEX. ..EDWARDS.. 07/09/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS ASIDE FROM SOME HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS EXTREME EASTERN SD/MUCH OF EASTERN SD INTO PARTS OF FAR NORTHWEST MN AND CENTRAL/SOUTHERN MN...BUT LIKELY ON AN INCREASINGLY MARGINAL/ISOLATED BASIS. SEVERE TSTM WATCH 403 CONTINUES...BUT AN ADDITIONAL WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY EXPECTED TO ITS EAST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TWO DISTINCT QUASI-LINEAR MCS/S CONTINUE TO PERSIST OVERNIGHT...ONE ACROSS FAR NORTHEAST ND /NEARING I-29/ AS OF 0730Z...WITH ANOTHER MOVING EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL SD. ACROSS NORTHEAST ND...EXISTING MCS WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE EAST-NORTHEASTWARD INTO FAR NORTHWEST MN IN NEAR/SOUTH OF SOUTHWEST-NORTHEAST ORIENTED FRONTAL ZONE. WHILE STRONG/NEAR-SEVERE WIND GUSTS MAY REMAIN POSSIBLE IN THE SHORT-TERM GIVEN THE MODEST INTEGRITY OF THE LINE AND POSSIBLE MCV/REAR-INFLOW INFLUENCES /REFERENCE BISMARCK WSR-88D VWP/...CONTINUALLY INCREASING BOUNDARY LAYER INHIBITION AND PROGRESSIVELY ELEVATED INFLOW SHOULD ONLY ALLOW FOR A MARGINAL /AT MOST/ NEAR-SURFACE SEVERE WIND POTENTIAL THE REST OF THE OVERNIGHT. MEANWHILE...STORM CONSOLIDATION...VIA A DIMINISHING SQUALL LINE OVERTAKING LEADING SEMI-DISCRETE ELEVATED STORMS...IS OCCURRING ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL SD NEAR/NORTH OF I-90 INCLUDING AREAS FROM ABERDEEN TO HURON. RECENT MEASURED GUSTS INCLUDE 41 KT AT BOTH ABERDEEN/PIERRE. PROBABLE INFLUENCE OF A MID-LEVEL IMPULSE/INCREASING WARM ADVECTION WILL LIKELY MAINTAIN A CLUSTER OF STORMS INTO CENTRAL/SOUTHERN MN EARLY THIS MORNING WITHIN A RELATIVELY MOIST/UNSTABLE CORRIDOR NORTH OF AN EFFECTIVE WARM FRONT. BUT...BARRING UNFORESEEN ORGANIZATION/ACCELERATION OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE...WHICH CANNOT BE ENTIRELY DISCOUNTED GIVEN THE INCREASING LOW LEVEL JET INFLUENCE/POTENTIAL FOR FORWARD PROPAGATION...THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG/SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL LIKELY REMAIN MARGINAL THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING GIVEN AMPLE LOW-LEVEL INHIBITION. ..GUYER.. 07/09/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
